Herb Chicken Tray Bake

Chicken, vegetables and herbs baked together on one tray.

Ingredients

  • 4 chicken thighs
  • 500 g potatoes
  • 2 carrots
  • 1 red onion
  • 3 cloves garlic
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tsp dried thyme
  • 1 tsp rosemary
  • 1 lemon
  • 100 ml chicken stock
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 pinch black pepper

Instructions

  1. Heat the oven to 200 degrees and line a baking tray.
  2. Cut potatoes, carrots and onion into similar pieces.
  3. Rub chicken thighs with oil, salt, pepper and herbs.
  4. Spread vegetables on the tray and place chicken on top.
  5. Add garlic, lemon slices and chicken stock around the tray.
  6. Bake until the chicken skin is golden and crisp.
  7. Turn the vegetables once during cooking for even color.
  8. Rest the tray bake for five minutes before serving.
  9. Serve with pan juices spooned over the chicken.
